name: ULBLANC
overview: ULBLANC is a comprehensive skincare workstation combining dual-frequency ultrasound for tightening with acoustic cavitation for transdermal drug delivery.
description: The system allows for effective treatment without damaging the skin surface, featuring Dynamic Dual Wave technology for both superficial and deep tissue treatment.

keyTechnologies.name: Sono-I (Dynamic Dual Wave™)
keyTechnologies.description: Alternates between different ultrasound frequencies to target both epidermis and dermis. 1/3 MHz for deep dermal tightening, 3/10 MHz for epidermal soothing.

keyTechnologies.name: i-Booster (Sonophoresis)
keyTechnologies.description: Utilizes 28kHz ultrasound to generate acoustic cavitation (micro-jet effect), opening micro-pathways for deep transdermal delivery of active ingredients.

handpieces.name: Sono-I Handpiece (Face)
handpieces.feature: Dual-wave technology for comprehensive facial treatment

handpieces.name: i-Booster Handpiece
handpieces.feature: 28kHz ultrasound for enhanced active ingredient delivery

clinicalBenefits: Versatile treatment range from soothing to lifting

differentiators.description: Alternating frequency technology targets both superficial and deep tissue layers in a single treatment session
28kHz acoustic cavitation creates micro-pathways for 10x better absorption of active ingredients
Gentle enough for sensitive skin conditions while delivering effective results
